book.name: 1 Korintofɔ
book.title: Ɔwʋlʋ́ Gyankpapʋá Paulo Lɔ́wanlɩ́n Sɩ́sɩ́ Korintofɔ

content: Bulu Asúmpʋ́
Apíó, brɛ́á nɛba mlɩ wá á, mmɛtalɩ́ tɔ́ɩ́ mlɩ ansɩ́tɔ́ fɛ́ ahá ánɩ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ bʋ amʋ́tɔ́. Nɛbláa mlɩ asʋ́n fɛ́ ahá ánɩ́ amʋ́ agywɩɩn ɩdɩn ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ atɔ́sʋ́, bʋmɔkʋ́dan Kristotɔ.
Nyɔ́pʋ-ntsu nɛha mlɩ. Mmɛha mlɩ atogyihɛ onutó. Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, mlɩmɔ́kʋ́fʋn atogyihɛ onutó gyí.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ tsiátɔ́ ɩtráa bʋ mlɩtɔ. Mlɩdɛ́ aba lu, mlɩdɛ́trɛ́. Nɩ́ mlɩdɛ́ ɩ́nɩ bwɛ mɛ́, imosuná ánɩ́ mlɩ agywɩɩn trá dɩn ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ atɔ́sʋ́, mlɩgyí fɛ́ ɔmátɔ́fɔ?
Mlɩtɔ akʋ mlɩaa, “Paulo mbuo.” Mlɩtɔ akʋ ɛ́ mlɩaa, “Apolo mbuo.” Mbɛ́ɛ, ɩ́nɩ medésuná ánɩ́ mlɩgyí fɛ́ ɔmátɔ́fɔ?
Mbɛ́ɛ, ma gyí Apolo, ntɛ́ɛ ma gyí Paulo, sʋ́ mlɩdɛ́trɛ́ anɩ sʋ? Bulu asúmpʋ́ kɛkɛ anɩgyí, mlɩlatsʋn anɩ ɩbɩtɔ mlí mʋ ahógyipʋ. Anɩtɔ okugyíɔkʋ légyi gyʋma ánɩ́ Bulu lɛ́ha mʋ.
Mɩ́lódu, Apolo lɔ́wʋlɩ́ mʋ́ ntsu, támɛ Bulu lɛ́ha mʋ́ ɩlɛdan.
Megyí odupʋ́ mʋ́a ntsu ɔwʋlɩ́pʋ́ lɔ́bwɛ tɔtɔ. Bulu nkʋlɛ tɔ́bwɛ, tsúfɛ́ mʋtɛ́há mʋ́ ɩtɛdan.
Odupʋ́ mʋ́a ntsu ɔwʋlɩ́pʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋgyi kɛ́kɛ́ɛ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́, ɔbɛ́ka okugyíɔkʋ ɩkɔ mʋ bwɛhɛ́ ɔnɔ́.
Agyʋ́má ayɔpʋ́ mɩ́a Apolo anɩgyí há Bulu. Mlɩgyí Bulu ndɔ, mlɩgyí mʋ obu ɛ́ nɩ́.
Bulu lɔ́wa awɩtɔlɛ há mɩ́, bwɛ́ mɩ́ obu oyípʋ ɔtɩansɩpʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ́ nɔpʋ abwi wá obu ámʋ ntswɩasɩ, aha bambá bɛtalɩ́ bʋdɛpwɛ dɩ́nká mʋ́sʋ́ nɩ́. Támɛ ɔhagyíɔha ɔkɩ́ɩ wankláán obu ámʋ pwɛtɔ́.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔhaa mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ wá ntswɩasɩ bámbá dʋn mʋ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩda yaɩ́, igyi Yesu Kristo amʋ.
Nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɔpʋ́ sika pɛpɛ o, sika futútú o, abwi ánɩ́ ɩbʋ bíá o, nyí o, afɩtáa ntɛ́ɛ ipí yi dɩ́nká ntswɩasɩ ámʋsʋ á,
ɔbɩ́ɩ ánɩ́ kugyíkʋ ɩbɛ́lɩn ɔwan ɛkɛ ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu obégyi anɩ asʋ́n ámʋ. Ogyá ɔbɔ́pʋsɔ mʋ́ kɩ bɛɛ, ɔlɔbwɛ mʋ́ wankláán.
Nɩ́ ogyá ámʋ mɔhɔ obu ámʋ yíntá á, Bulu ɔbɛ́da mʋ ɩpán.
Támɛ nɩ́ obu ámʋ lɔ́hɔ a, ɔbɛ́hɩɛ hʋ́lɩ atɔ́. Bulu ɔbɔ́hɔ mʋ nkpa, támɛ obófuflu fɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ alasrɩ́ dalɩ ogya plɛnplɛntɔ.
Mlɩméyín ánɩ́ Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa mlɩgyí, Bulu Ɔŋɛ́ ámʋ tsie mlɩtɔ?
Ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ oleyintá mʋ ɔtswɛ́kpa a, Bulu ɛ́ obéyintá mʋ, tsúfɛ́ Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa lɔwankɩ́. Mʋ ɔtswɛ́kpa amʋ gyí mlɩ á.
Ɔhaa mámlɛ́ mʋ ɩwɩ! Nɩ́ mlɩtɔ ɔkʋ dɛ́ mʋ ɩwɩ tɩ ɔtɩansɩpʋ ndɛ ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ á, ilehián ánɩ́ ɔbɔ́bwɛ mʋ ɩwɩ ɔha mimláhɛ, mɛ́nɩ ɔbɔ́bwɛ ɔtɩansɩpʋ onutó.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔyɩ́ ánfɩtɔ ansɩtɩ́ɩn igyi mimlála Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́. Fɛ́ alɩá bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋtɔ bɛɛ, “Ɔtɩansɩpʋ agywɩɩn laláhɛ Bulu tɔpʋ́kɩ́tá mʋ.”
Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ lɛtrá blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bulu yin ánɩ́ ɔtɩansɩpʋ agywɩɩn itépí ma labi.”
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔhaa mápʋ ansɩ́ dɩ́nká ɔhaasʋ tsú ɩwɩ. Mlɩbʋ́ tógyítɔ́.
Paulo o, Apolo o, Petro o, ɔyɩ́ ánfɩ o, nkpa ntɛ́ɛ lowu o, ndɛ o, ɔkɛ o, mlɩbʋ́ mʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́.
Kristo bʋ́ mlɩ, Kristo ɛ́ gyí Bulu klɛ́.
